data.content: # Coventry City vs Newcastle United – Predicted lineup and team news. **Coventry City host Newcastle United on Monday night looking to win at home for the first time this season, in the league or any cup.**. ## Coventry City team news. Milan van Ewijk (hamstring) returned to training during the week and is expected back in the matchday squad. Kaine Kesler-Hayden (hamstring) is also back on the training pitch but has not played since May. Caleb Yirenkyi filled in at right wing-back at Forest, and Lampard is likely to keep him there, leaving Van Ewijk on the bench. Ethan Pinnock and Bobby Thomas kept the clean sheet at the City Ground, with Stephen Mfuni covering for Amenda in the back three. ## Coventry City predicted lineup. **Coventry City possible starting XI:** Rushworth; Mfuni, Pinnock, Thomas; Yirenkyi, Grimes, Onyeka, Dasilva; Rudoni, Mason-Clark; Thomas-Asante. ## How to watch Coventry City vs Newcastle United?
